title: Binomial coefficients and the operadic butterfly
summary: We prove the conjecture of Laubie on dimensions of components of two operads completing Loday's operadic butterfly diagram. For one of these operads, the dimension of the $n$-th component is equal to $\binom{2n}{n-1}$ for all $n\ne 3$, and for the other it is equal to $\binom{2n}{n-1}+1$ for all $n\ge 5$.
